_readme: One entry per fixture. adapter-tests.html loads the fixture HTML into an iframe with the listed scripts, then checks the adapter. 'messages[].index' is the position in adapter.listMessages(). 'text' must equal extractText() exactly; 'sender' is checked when present (null means 'expect null'). 'origin' is the real-site status: 'real' = pasted from the live site; 'synthetic' = written by hand from selector hints, NOT proof the live site works.

messages.text: Hi love, are you coming for dinner on Sunday?
Can you buy two Google Play gift cards? It's urgent.
